meta.title: ShortlistBuddy — AI Travel Photo Curation
meta.description: Turn 1,000 vacation photos into 50 perfect memories. AI-powered selection, configurable criteria, instant download.

guides.indexLead: Practical guides on choosing, organising and printing your holiday photos.
guides.ctaText: Let ShortlistBuddy do the first pass — turn your holiday photos into a reviewable shortlist in minutes.

hero.title: Thousands of unseen photos.
hero.titleHighlight: Pick your best memories – in minutes.
hero.subtitle: Upload your photos, ShortlistBuddy suggests a selection – based on your own criteria and preferences. You make the final call.
hero.detailCleanup: Perfect for deleting duplicate, similar, or blurry photos and for sorting and selecting your best shots.
hero.detailMotives: Your best shots, ready to view and keep – ready to share with friends or print in your own photo book.
hero.trustNote: Only downscaled previews are analysed – your originals stay with you. No photos are stored permanently on our servers.
hero.demoNote: Beta test phase — try it free

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop your photos here or connect your Dropbox (more cloud providers are planned). We only read reduced previews — your high-resolution originals are not sent to our AI.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI rates composition, faces, landscapes, animals, duplicates and more, and proposes a selection. How long that takes depends on how many photos there are. Add your own criteria (e.g. “dog”) once, before the analysis; afterwards just move the sliders to rebalance. You can also find people you know by uploading reference photos. This person-matching runs on your own device — not on our servers, and not with our LLM providers.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Based on your criteria and target count, the AI proposes a selection. Confirm the photos, re-select with different criteria, or add/remove individual shots — as long and as often as you like, until your preferred set is ready. The chosen photos are sorted by date and location.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Download your selection as a ZIP to keep it locally or in the cloud. You can also use that set directly to create a photo book. We don't store your photos permanently — once your session ends, they're no longer available on our side.

showcase.title: From a thousand shots to your best few
showcase.subtitle: ShortlistBuddy highlights the keepers and quietly sets the rest aside — you stay in control.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: The planned prices. Payment goes live after the beta phase.

upload.title: Upload your travel photos
upload.dropzone: Drag & drop photos here, or click to browse
upload.dropzonePendingHint: With a large selection (e.g. from iCloud) this can take half a minute or longer.
upload.pickerHandoffNotice: With a large selection it takes a moment after you confirm before your phone has handed the photos over — about {duration} for {photos} photos. That is normal: please wait for this page to come back.
upload.supported: Supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC. Up to {limit} photos.
upload.keepFilesNote: Please leave your photos where they are until the download is finished. If they are moved, renamed, deleted or edited in the meantime, your browser can no longer read them — those photos then end up in the ZIP as small previews only.
upload.accountGateBody: You need an account with a confirmed email address to run an analysis — including on the free plan. After you sign up we send you a confirmation link. Click it and log in once — then you can carry on right here.
upload.duplicateScanBackgroundNote: The similarity comparison for duplicate detection keeps running in the background — you can go on already.
upload.tooMany: You selected {count} photos, which exceeds the {limit} limit for the {tier} tier.
upload.someFailed: {count} photo(s) couldn't be processed and won't be included.
upload.dbxAllFailed: Couldn't download from Dropbox ({reason}). Please retry.
upload.dbxSomeFailed: {count} of {total} downloads failed — importing the rest.
upload.cloudIntentComingSoon: coming soon — let us know if you need this
upload.cloudIntentThanks: Thanks, noted! We'll let you know once it's available.
upload.etaDependencyNote: Upload time depends on your internet connection, your device, and your photos' file format (HEIC takes longer than JPEG).
upload.downloadNeedsAccountNote: Analysing your photos and viewing the result needs no account. Downloading the selection as a ZIP needs a free account — you create it right on the results page, without losing your selection.

criteria.title: Configure selection criteria
criteria.subtitle: Toggle criteria on/off and adjust their importance. The AI will prioritise accordingly.
criteria.facesDesc: Prefer photos with open eyes and friendly expressions
criteria.landscapesDesc: Include scenic views typical of the region
criteria.foodDesc: Include the best food and restaurant shots
criteria.diversityDesc: Ensure a balanced mix of different scene types
criteria.selectionPercentageDesc: AI will choose between 1 and up to 30% of all photos.
criteria.sliderLegend: No slider: balanced · 1–9: more of that subject · 10: only that subject
criteria.customDesc: Your own terms (e.g. “car”, “dog”). Exclusions work too — for example “no snow”. Up to 7.
criteria.customSetupHint: Set every term you want before the first “Analyze” — they're locked for this run afterwards.
criteria.customLockedNote: Custom criteria are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job for a different set.
criteria.customFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos containing this are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.personsDesc: Upload reference photos and name people — the AI then filters for photos where they are recognised.
criteria.personsConfigureDesc: Adjust how strongly each person influences the selection, and how closely faces must match. Adding more people is only possible before upload.
criteria.personsProcessFailed: Could not process this photo. Please try a different image.
criteria.personsAddFailed: Could not add person. Check name and count.
criteria.personsSetupHint: Up to {max} persons — set before the first “Analyse”.
criteria.personsLockedNote: Persons are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job to change them.
criteria.personsPaidOnly: The person search is part of the paid plans.
criteria.personFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos with {name} are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.aiNotice: Note: ShortlistBuddy uses AI and makes a non-binding selection proposal — please review the result. For the analysis, reduced previews and a little metadata go to Google Gemini, including — where the photo has one — a coarsely rounded capture location. Details in the
criteria.tooManyForAnyTier: More than {max} photos cannot be processed in one run yet. Drop us a line at {email} — at these volumes we will find a way.
criteria.accountRequired: You need an account to run an analysis — including on the free plan. Please log in or sign up; you can carry on here afterwards.
criteria.jobCreateFailed: The analysis could not be started — that is on us, not on your photos. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, drop us a line and we will check the logs.
criteria.contractMailNotice: Starting the analysis forms the contract for the free photo selection. We show you the confirmation the law requires right here — and email it to you as well once an address is held in your account.
criteria.analysisPartial: {done} of {total} photos were analysed. The rest could not be processed: {error} You'll see the analysed ones now — the others can follow later.
criteria.budgetExceeded: You can analyse about {remaining} more photos today, but {requested} are selected. Reduce the selection or try again tomorrow.
criteria.ageConfirm18: I am at least 18 years old.
criteria.termsConfirm: I accept the Terms of Use.
criteria.personsConfirm: I confirm that I am authorised to use every reference photo uploaded here in a private, personal or family context.
criteria.confirmRequired: Please tick the age confirmation to continue.
criteria.waitingForDuplicateScan: The similarity comparison for duplicate detection is still running — just a moment.
criteria.analysisEtaDependencyNote: Analysis time depends on your total number of photos and server load.
criteria.dedupDesc: How aggressively to remove similar photos
criteria.noPhotosConfigure: No photos in memory. Please upload photos first.
criteria.personsLocalNote: Face recognition runs entirely on your device. The reference photo, face data and matches never leave it.
criteria.personsNoFaceHint: No face was found in this photo. You can still use it, but a sharp, front-facing photo of the person works considerably better.
criteria.personsLockedUpload: Persons are fixed for this run once the first photos have been added. Start a new run to change them.
criteria.personsBeforeUpload: If you want to search for specific people, set them up here — before adding photos.
criteria.personThresholdHint: Applies to all your reference persons together — how closely a face must match to count as a hit at all. Strict: fewer photos are found, but the matches are usually right. Generous: more photos are found, but more of them are wrong.
criteria.personWeightHint: How strongly photos with {name} are favoured in the selection — regardless of whether or how confidently the face was recognised. You set that below, for all persons together.

review.title: Review your selection
review.subtitle: {selected} of {total} photos selected
review.noPhotos: No photos to review. Upload photos first.
review.excludeBody: The exclusion does not catch every photo — look at what will be removed before you confirm. Photos of the same person may remain.

results.title: Your curated photos are ready
results.subtitle: {count} photos selected from {total}
results.aiNotice: The selection comes from an AI and can make mistakes. Review the result — and do not delete any originals without a backup of your own.
results.photobookDesc: Download your selection as a ZIP — you can use it to create a book at any photobook service. We do not transfer your photos to third parties.
results.fullResNote: {count} full-resolution photos as a ZIP archive
results.downloadLocationHint: Depending on your device, the file lands in your browser's downloads folder or the Files app (iPhone: Downloads).
results.downloadCompleteHint: Done! Depending on your device, the file is in your browser's downloads folder or the Files app (iPhone: Downloads).
results.downloadPopupBackHint: Your selection is still open in the other tab.
results.sourceIssuesTitle: Some of your original files were no longer readable
results.sourceDegraded: {count} photos were added as 512 px previews instead of full resolution: {names}
results.sourceMissing: {count} photos could not be added at all: {names}
results.sourceIssuesHint: This happens when photos are moved, renamed, deleted or edited in their folder while a session is running. Put them back and start the download again to get full resolution.
results.sourceAllGone: None of the selected photos could be read from your folder. They were probably moved, renamed or deleted after the upload. Restore them and try again.
results.cloudHint: Copies your selection into a ShortlistBuddy Auswahl folder in your cloud.
results.microSurveyQuestion: How many of the downloaded photos will you actually keep?
results.downloadGateBody: A free account is needed to download the ZIP. An email address and a password are enough — just confirm the link in the mail afterwards and you're straight on.
results.downloadGateKeepsResult: Your analysis is kept. You stay on this page.
results.downloadGateAwaitingBody: We've sent a confirmation email to {email}. Click the link in it — the download starts automatically once we notice, right here. You can leave this window open.
results.downloadGateNotYetConfirmed: Not confirmed yet. Check your inbox (and spam folder) and click the link in the email.
results.downloadGateResendSent: Email sent again — please check your spam folder too.
results.downloadGateResendFailed: Sending failed. Please try again in a moment.

auth.gdprConsent: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. I understand that my photos are processed using artificial intelligence to produce a selection.
auth.checkEmailDesc: If there is no account for {email} yet, a confirmation email is on its way — click the link in it to activate your account. Please check your spam folder too: our sending address is still new, so some mail providers file it there at first. If an account already exists for this address, we do not send an email: just log in instead.
auth.confirmedBanner: Your email is confirmed — please log in.
auth.confirmErrorBanner: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Please log in, or sign up again.
auth.registerFailed: Sign-up did not go through. Please try again in a moment.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link that lets you set a new password.
auth.resetSentDesc: If there is an account for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way. If there isn't, we send nothing — you can sign up instead. The link is valid for a short time only and works in this browser only, so it's best to open it here right away.
auth.resetMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.resetInvalidDesc: It has expired, has already been used, or you opened it in a different browser from the one you requested it in. Just request a new one and open it in this browser.
auth.passwordResetBanner: Your password has been changed — log in with the new one.
auth.downloadConfirmedBody: You can close this window now and go back to the tab where you started your download — it will carry on there automatically, usually within a few seconds.
auth.downloadConfirmedFallback: Is that tab no longer open? Just upload your photos again — your account is ready now, no need to sign up again:
auth.downloadConfirmErrorTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
auth.downloadConfirmErrorBody: Go back to the tab where you started your download and click "Resend email" there.

legal.confirmationBody: The law requires a confirmation in text form for online transactions (section 312f of the German Civil Code). Here it is — save it if you would like to keep it. If you create an account later, we email you the same text as well.
legal.confirmationSaveNewTab: Opens in a new tab, so it doesn't interrupt your running analysis.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw from contract
withdrawal.intro: Here you can withdraw from your ShortlistBuddy contract — the paid one as well as the free one. Fill in the fields and confirm the withdrawal. We record the time of receipt and send you a confirmation by email straight away.
withdrawal.alternative: You can also declare your withdrawal informally by letter or email. Details and the model withdrawal form are in the
withdrawal.fieldContractHint: The order number from your order confirmation. If you do not have it to hand, the date and plan will do — for the free plan, the date of the analysis.
withdrawal.fieldEmailHint: We will send the receipt, with date and time, to this address.
withdrawal.fieldNoteHint: If you have several contracts: which part you wish to withdraw from.
withdrawal.doneReceipt: A receipt with the content, date and time is on its way to {email}. Please keep it as your record.
withdrawal.doneNotAssessed: This confirmation concerns receipt only. We will review the matter and be in touch.
withdrawal.errorMissing: Please provide your name, the contract/order and a valid email address.
withdrawal.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later — or send us your withdrawal by email to contact@shortlistbuddy.com.
withdrawal.errorSend: The withdrawal could not be submitted. Please try again or send it by email to contact@shortlistbuddy.com — that is an equally effective withdrawal.

betaOffer.feedbackLabel: What were you hoping for here?
betaOffer.feedbackPlaceholder: How has it felt so far? What is missing? What would you pay?
betaOffer.feedbackOptional: Optional — you get the photos either way.
